review_note: Drafted by one Claude session and reviewed by a different Claude session (9 of 40 tasks changed; log in evals/out/m11). All tasks are TEST tasks; no retrieval tool was run to write or review them, so nothing is tuned. The repository owner has not reviewed this set.

tasks.query: sanitize a field against CSV injection: escape or strip leading formula characters, or throw when an injection character is detected
tasks.note: CsvWriter.SanitizeForInjection checks the first character against the injection characters and then throws, escapes or strips depending on InjectionOptions.

tasks.query: pick the constructor whose parameter types exactly or loosely match the given argument types, throwing on an ambiguous match
tasks.note: ObjectCreator.GetConstructor returns the exact-match constructor, a single fuzzy match, or throws AmbiguousMatchException or a not-found exception.

tasks.query: check whether a type already appears in the list of parent map types to detect a circular reference
tasks.note: ClassMap.CheckForCircularReference walks the mapParents linked list backwards looking for the given type.

tasks.query: trim characters from the start and end of a char buffer by adjusting the start and length arguments
tasks.note: ArrayHelper.Trim advances start and reduces length while the edge characters are in the trim set.

tasks.query: merge several type converter options by applying each source in order, only overriding the boolean and null value lists when they differ from the defaults
tasks.note: TypeConverterOptions.Merge applies each non-null source onto the first and only replaces the true/false/null value lists when they differ from defaults.

tasks.query: build the dictionary mapping prepared header names to lists of column indexes, clearing the named index cache first
tasks.note: CsvReader.ParseNamedIndexes clears namedIndexes and namedIndexCache and fills namedIndexes from the prepared header names.

tasks.query: walk up the inheritance tree to find the generic ClassMap base type of a map class
tasks.note: ClassMapCollection.GetGenericCsvClassMapType recurses through BaseType until the generic type definition is ClassMap<>.

tasks.query: double the size of the entries and buckets arrays and rehash the entries when the field cache is full
tasks.note: FieldCache.Resize doubles the size, copies entries and rebuilds the bucket chains.

tasks.query: append a string value to the internal write buffer, doubling the buffer size when the needed length would not fit
tasks.note: CsvWriter.WriteToBuffer grows the char buffer by doubling and copies the value at bufferPosition.

tasks.query: throw an error saying you must call read before accessing data when the reader has not been read yet
tasks.note: CsvReader.CheckHasBeenRead throws a ReaderException when hasBeenRead is false.

tasks.query: decide whether an outgoing value must be wrapped in the text qualifier: leading or trailing space, a line break, or the separator appears inside
tasks.note: ConfigurationFunctions.ShouldQuote is the default predicate testing for space edges, quote, newline and delimiter.

tasks.query: turns cell text into true or false, accepting 0 and 1 and user-configured yes/no style words compared case-insensitively
tasks.note: BooleanConverter.ConvertFromString tries bool.TryParse, 0/1 shorts, then the configured true/false value lists ignoring case.

tasks.query: builds the diagnostic block appended to error messages with reader, parser and writer state such as row numbers, column count and raw data, hiding raw data when disabled
tasks.note: CsvHelperException.AddDetails composes the IReader/IParser/IWriter state lines and honours ExceptionMessagesContainRawData.

tasks.query: renders binary data as uppercase two-digit base-16 pairs, with an optional 0x prefix and optional dash separators
tasks.note: ByteArrayConverter.ByteArrayToHexString appends 0x if requested then each byte as X2, joined by the dash prefix.

tasks.query: compiles a lambda that assigns every mapped property and nested reference on an already existing instance from the current row
tasks.note: RecordHydrator.CreateHydrateRecordAction builds member assignments from the map for an existing object and compiles an Action<T>.

tasks.query: detects compiler-generated nameless classes, such as those produced by new { A = 1 } expressions, by checking generic-type attributes and the naming prefix
tasks.note: ReflectionExtensions.IsAnonymous checks CompilerGenerated, generic, name contains AnonymousType with <> or VB$ prefix, and not public.

tasks.query: shifts the unconsumed characters to the front, grows the character array when a row is longer than it, and pulls more text from the underlying stream
tasks.note: CsvParser.FillBuffer doubles the buffer if the row fills it, moves the leftover chars to index 0 and reads more from the TextReader; FillBufferAsync is its line-for-line async twin and equally correct.

tasks.query: returns null for empty text or any configured null marker, otherwise delegates to the wrapped underlying type's conversion
tasks.note: NullableConverter.ConvertFromString returns null for empty or NullValues text and otherwise calls UnderlyingTypeConverter.

tasks.query: find a column position by header text, falling back to a case-insensitive comparison of normalised names, and throw index out of range if missing
tasks.note: CsvDataReader.GetOrdinal tries GetFieldIndex, then compares prepared header names ignoring case, else throws IndexOutOfRangeException.

tasks.query: finalize the last row when the input ends without a line terminator, adding the remaining cells depending on the previous token
tasks.note: CsvParser.ReadEndOfFile inspects the saved parser state and adds the trailing fields for delimiter, line ending or new line states.

tasks.query: how are CSV rows turned into strongly typed objects: choosing a creator for the type, compiling a delegate that assigns each mapped member from the current row
tasks.note: RecordManager asks the factory for a creator, ObjectRecordCreator compiles the lambda, and ExpressionManager builds the member assignments.

tasks.query: how a class instance is written as a CSV row: the writer picks a writer strategy for the type and compiles a delegate that converts each mapped member to text and writes it
tasks.note: CsvWriter.WriteRecord gets a write delegate from RecordManager, the factory picks the writer, and ObjectRecordWriter compiles the per-member writes.

tasks.query: automatic separator detection: when the first chunk of text is loaded, candidate characters are counted per line outside quoted text and the best one replaces the current delimiter
tasks.note: CsvParser.DetectDelimiter passes the first text to the configuration function, and ConfigurationFunctions.GetDelimiter counts and ranks candidates.

tasks.query: what happens when a class-mapped column is missing from the header row: collecting the invalid headers, then the callback that raises an error listing them
tasks.note: CsvReader.ValidateHeader (public entry, Type overload, and the protected ClassMap overload that collects InvalidHeader entries all belong to the chain) feeds ConfigurationFunctions.HeaderValidated, which builds the message and throws.

tasks.query: auto-mapping a class's members by reflection: collecting properties up the base classes with hidden-by-new handling, finding the declaring type, and skipping ignored members
tasks.note: ClassMap.AutoMapMembers uses ReflectionHelper to collect unique and declaring properties then builds member and reference maps.

tasks.query: a quoted cell with a stray quote character in the middle: the callback that fires, its default behaviour that throws, and how the malformed text is salvaged
tasks.note: ProcessRFC4180BadField invokes badDataFound and salvages the text; the default BadDataFound callback throws.

tasks.query: reading rows as dynamic objects: property names come from the header (or Field1, Field2 with no header) and values are stored in a dictionary-backed object
tasks.note: DynamicRecordCreator fills a FastDynamicObject using property names produced by GetDynamicPropertyName.

tasks.query: writing dynamic or expando records: header and value order come from member names, optionally sorted by a configured comparer
tasks.note: The dynamic and expando record writers write values in (optionally sorted) member order and WriteDynamicHeader writes the matching header.

tasks.query: reading into immutable types without a parameterless constructor: deciding to use constructor-parameter mapping, mapping each parameter, and building the argument expressions
tasks.note: ShouldUseConstructorParameters decides the strategy, AutoMapConstructorParameters builds parameter maps, and ExpressionManager builds the argument expressions.

tasks.query: how text becomes an enum value: custom names from attributes on enum members, case-insensitive matching, and when the factory defers to a user-registered generic enum converter
tasks.note: EnumConverter's constructor indexes Name attributes, ConvertFromString parses with optional ignore-case, and EnumConverterFactory.Create picks or defers the converter.
